description: Verse values an item from a photo: the vision model describes it and Verse gives an estimated value range with what it saw. People are never priced. One call, one appraisal. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/appraise.

image.description: a PNG, JPEG or WebP data URL, under 800 KB

name: paid_appraise
title: Appraise an item from a photo (0.05 USDC, x402)
